title: 24/7 Studio Membership with Gas Reduction, Raku and Pit Firings
how_to_join: Join the Waitlist; wait time 18-24 months
source_quote: Inclusion in approximately 6 firings per year in our gas reduction kiln. 4+ bisque firings per month. 10+ electric cone 6 firings per year. Options to participate in Raku and Pit firings.
evidence_sentence: Members receive inclusion in approximately 6 gas reduction firings per year and have options to participate in Raku and Pit firings.
evidence_quote: Inclusion in approximately 6 firings per year in our gas reduction kiln.
summary: JBCP membership includes access to approximately 6 gas reduction firings per year plus options for raku and pit barrel firings. Currently on an 18-24 month waitlist.
